quest.title: Her Secret
quest.description: You have agreed to meet Kokomi near Sangonomiya Shrine. Time to move out.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x375, Mora x26025, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

chapter.title: Warriors' Dreams Like Spring Grass Renewing

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Kokomi isn't here yet...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's weird. She doesn't seem like the type to show up late to things... Eh, let's wait a while longer.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How is she still not here? Do you think she could be in trouble?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go ask that soldier over there.

talks.objective: Wait for Kokomi near the Sangonomiya Shrine

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa... Look at all these petitions.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So does Kokomi make time to deal with these even when she's resting?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Sangonomiya Events Cash Flow Statement," "Consolidated Annual Report on Fishing Production," "Watatsumi Island Monthly Maintenance Expenses Breakdown"...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is a lot of work for one person. And it's on top of all the directives she has to write and the people she has to meet day-to-day. It's no wonder she gets burnt out from time to time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's track down that book and help her feel like herself again!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kokomi!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So this is where you ran off to! We were gonna meet up and get things ready for the Victory Feast today, what happened?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Oh... It's you...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: I—I apologize... I'm not feeling my usual self today.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *gasp* You got sick? We'll go find a doctor right away!

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: No no, it's nothing like that... It's just, my energy is completely spent.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Y—You run on energy? *gasp* You mean... you're like a Ruin Guard!?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: No, it's just a figure of speech. *sigh* I'm ashamed to admit it, but I can't always be the infinitely capable person I present myself as.

choices.text: Everyone was asking so much of you yesterday...

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Oh... you noticed? I guess I haven't quite mastered the ability to hide how I'm feeling. I'll keep working at it...

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: To be honest, I'm not really cut out to be a leader. At first, my dream was to read up on military strategy and perhaps become an adviser.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Constantly communicating with people, trying to retain their morale, having to read between the lines, making sure everyone gets the recognition they deserve... It's such hard work.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: You're somehow supposed to make people feel wonderful just from being in your presence, while also commanding their respect... It doesn't come naturally to me. Truth be told, it's something I never wanted for myself.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: But because of my bloodline, I was always going to end up being the Divine Priestess sooner or later. Like it or not, it's just the way it is.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: So whenever I feel overwhelmed, I come here to just lose myself in a book and relax for a while...

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Don't worry, it doesn't affect my work. I handed over preparations for the Victory Feast to someone else.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: I have to make a speech tonight, and I mustn't give the troops any reason to suspect that something could be wrong. This peace was hard-won, and I want them to feel at ease.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is there anything we can do to help?

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: I should be feeling energized again soon if I hold off on work for a little longer. *sigh* If only there were some way I could listen to a good read on military strategy, I'm sure that'd speed up the process...

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: I was reading a book last time I was here, but I only got about halfway through. Where did I put it...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We'll find it for you!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And then we'll read it out to you — to help you recover!

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: You'd do that for me? Thank you.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Hehe... I'm really lucky you came back to Watatsumi Island.

choices.text: I could sense things were getting to you.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Ahh... I don't even want to move right now.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: It'd be so nice if all my work could just do itself without me having to lift a finger...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hey, look, {NICKNAME}. Could this be the book she wanted?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Swordfish captain came back today. Energy +4..."

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Ah, that's... that's just, um...

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Give. It. Here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh-heh, guess that was the wrong one... Let's keep looking.

choices.text: (And if we did, it was all Paimon's fault.)

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: I'm actually pretty social when I have the energy.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Still, talking to people I don't know is really draining...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #It's gotta be this one, right, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look, there's even a bookmark. None of the other books have one, so she must have finished reading those already.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew, it's pretty dense. Paimon doesn't understand a thing...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, let's take it over and read it to her!

dialogues.speaker: Shibata
dialogues.text: Are you looking for Her Excellency?

dialogues.speaker: Shibata
dialogues.text: I'm afraid she isn't here at the moment. I don't know where she's gone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So strange... Guess we should just call it a rain check then?

dialogues.speaker: Shibata
dialogues.text: Not necessarily. If I recall correctly, Her Excellency has made special provisions for just such a scenario in her General Operational Directives.

dialogues.speaker: Shibata
dialogues.text: Let me see... Ah yes, No. 98. <color=#00E1FFFF> "Should a visitor from afar come to see me, and should my whereabouts be unknown, direct them to proceed southward until they arrive at a tree with purple foliage."</color>

dialogues.speaker: Shibata
dialogues.text: The footnote stipulates that this only applies when Her Excellency has made no communication regarding her whereabouts before disappearing, and even then only when the visitor in question is of VIP status.

dialogues.speaker: Shibata
dialogues.text: As far as I'm concerned, you two tick all of the boxes. I keep this directive on me at all times — I'm sure this is the right course of action.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kokomi really does think of everything! Alright, let's find the place she wrote about and have a look.

talks.objective: Read a book about military strategy to Kokomi

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kokomi, is this the book you wanted?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Hmm, I'm not sure, actually... Could you read a bit out loud?

choices.text: "Act to the plan, and plan to the situation"...

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: *yawns* Yes, that's the one! Thank you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Kokomi? Kokomi...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Oh no, she's fallen asleep. What're we gonna do, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Tonight's the Victory Feast! Not to mention that the peace talks are just around the corner. She's got so much to do...

choices.text: Let's let her rest a while.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You sure that's a good idea?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, she does look pretty exhausted. Guess there's still some time to go, too. Alright, let's keep her company while she rests.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Avoid disaster... Protect peace at all costs...

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: The war's over... Things are slowly getting better...

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Did you see...?

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Uhhhh... Huh? What time is it? Did I fall asleep?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup, you've been out for ages! It's nearly time for the feast!

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: I can't believe it got so late!

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: *sigh* I haven't slept that peacefully in so long. That's gotta be three whole energy points right there. Should be enough to see me through the peace talks.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: #Thank you, {NICKNAME}. Well, we better get ourselves over there, it's nearly time to light the bonfire.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Woohoo, Kokomi's back to full energy! Good to have you back!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We probably should, after all, she did say she wanted to wrap everything up before the feast kicks off!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Kokomi, wakey-wakey!

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Hmmmm...? Was I asleep? ...What time is it?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Time to get going! It's nearly time for the feast!

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Really? It's that time already? Ughhhh... I still don't feel like I'm fully recharged.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'll buy you a new book on military strategy.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Really? Yes! I want the latest volume of the Teyvat Art of War!

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: The Yae Publishing House published it last month, but I haven't had the chance to get my hands on it... No backing out now, okay?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, that really perked her up.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, let's get to the feast!

choices.text: "Attack where the enemy is weak, emerge where the enemy is blind"...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: ...You saw it, didn't you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you sure this is the right place? It feels like we keep heading deeper into the middle of nowhere...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hey, doesn't that tree look like the one she described in the directive, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It looks like there's a way in over there... Let's take a look!
